domain: Personal knowledge: one person's long-term, traceable knowledge across projects, collaboration, research and operations
summary: Compiles what will later be used for action, judgment, explanation, collaboration or audit into long-term knowledge with the owner as its subject; not a transcript summary, and not permanent storage of every input.

generations.summary: Evidence tiers, worked examples and counter-examples, frozen history volumes, first-class beginnings, and a closing self-check. Distills the three-generation lineage this project's own experiments ran.
Adds end-to-end image provenance: native IM images or labelled caption/OCR evidence share the cited L0 block; other native media remain explicitly unsupported.
